curvature: 100 * maximum perpendicular deviation from release-target line / release-target distance
diagnostic: Same all-pass trained models and calibrators; no refit, no filtering during training or calibration
missing_curvature: 49 missing values kept in main cohort and reported separately, never labelled curved

publication: Aggregates only; no raw tracking or per-pass data copied into the portfolio
